title: Françoise E NDE 8799
content: On May 2, 2018 at 1:15am I was a victim of an terrible car accident, that was sending me into a coma, and in which I had fractures of cerebellum, cervical vertebrae, liver, cranial trauma, pneumothorax with detachment of the lung. Then I was flown to the hospital. When I arrived into reanimation they told my parents that they didn't know if I would survive. I was dying. On 3rd of May, I saw myself standing at the foot end of my bed, with all my family and friends in the hospital room, I called them but they didn't hear me, suddenly I saw myself stretched out on my bed, connected all over, then I turned my head an there I saw a white light shining. I was looking at this light then I saw several shadows approaching, they happened to be deceased members of my family. I saw myself leaving towards them when suddenly my daddy, who unfortunately isn't of this world anymore, took my arm and told me that this place is not my place, that I still have to experience something on earth. He escorted me to my body, we said good bye and I woke up on the next day. At the beginning, I thought that I was dreaming or imagining this scene, so I was talking with my mom about it. It's at that moment that she told me that the doctors had to reanimate me as I was slowly dying. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: May 3, 2018 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Accident Direct head injury Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I heard the machines of the hospital room, as well as the crying of the people present. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I didn't feel any pain anymore, I felt good, appeased, serene. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? At the moment when I was leaving for this light to join the people who had left us. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. I saw the scene that happened there at that moment. Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was fuzzy, the light was bluish. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I don't remember. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes I saw several members of my family, my mare and my daddy. I also could talk to him and even touch him, hugging him. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes A blue light, then a white light appeared. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt good, I didn't feel any pain anymore, no anguish anymore, I felt in safety. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others I don't have the same view of the world than before living this experience. Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. My daddy stopped me from passing through, he told me that I had not yet finished my path on earth. I still don't know why he told me this. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I could see the hospital room, the section where I was, the people present in the room at that moment; when I returned to the hospital some time later I could exactly describe the floor, the room, the details. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes My whole way of looking at life and at the people surrounding me. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No I saw members of my family, my horse, and my daddy. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes I believe in everything that one cannot see, everything supernatural and there I got the proof. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes Knowledge that something exists after us. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Thanks to this experience I got the confirmation of my beliefs that there is life after death. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. Before I was very stressed, when I couldn't do or say something, I was annoyed, now I let life go as it comes. I also was fighting for the people I loved, now I notice that nobody would fight for me, so I will not do it anymore, I don't hold back anybody, I take life as it comes, as it was written. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I still see myself; I remember everything completely, even the feelings that I had when I was over there. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Already before my experience I sensed all those supernatural things, but afterwards they got more intense. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I could say good bye to my daddy and my horse. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes A few months passed before I talked about to my mother, she wasn't very surprised as she knew about my prior abilities, but she confirmed that I was dying when I experienced it. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes A member of my family had told having experienced one. And no, this didn't influence my experience as I had forgotten this story. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I didn't know if this experience was real or if it was only the fruit of my imagination. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. The fact of seeing my whole family, as I was very young when I lost certain members of my family. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: She reports deceased family members approaching; her deceased father took her arm, told her it was not her place and escorted her back.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Escorted back by her deceased father to her body; she said goodbye and then woke the next day.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Her father told her she still had to experience something on Earth and had not finished her path on Earth.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car accident with coma and multiple injuries (cervical vertebrae, liver, cranial trauma, pneumothorax/detached lung).

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in hospital room, then attention to a white light; deceased family approached; she moved toward them until stopped at a barrier and told to return; escorted back to body and woke the next day.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reports encountering her deceased horse ('my mare') along with deceased family members.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “My daddy… took my arm and told me that this place is not my place, that I still have to experience something on earth.”
